About the team:

The Rubrik Cloud Native Protection team helps customers secure their data on the cloud. Cloud data is growing at an ever growing pace and so are the risks with cyber attacks targeted towards cloud data.  We make it easy for businesses to protect, search, analyze all of their cloud data simply and scalably. 

Cloud Native Protection is one of the fastest growing businesses and teams within Rubrik.  We consider ourselves a startup inside a startup!  Join us in this journey where there are ever widening avenues to explore, opportunities to innovate, deep engineering problems to tackle.  We believe in fostering a culture with strong engineering values and teamwork as the key to building a great company and product.

About Role:

Rubrik Software Engineers are self-starters, driven, and can manage themselves. We believe in giving engineers responsibility, not tasks. Our goal is to motivate and challenge people to do their best work.  Bottom line, if you have a limitless drive and like to win, we want to talk to you - come make history! 

What you’ll do:

  • Build software using your strong background in distributed systems and cloud.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve the software.
  • Manage individual projects priorities, deadlines and deliverables with your technical expertise.

Experience you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science or related field
  • 0-2 years of relevant work experience, 
  • Proficiency in one or more general purpose programming languages like Go, Java, C/C++, Scala, Python
  • Experience with AWS/Azure/GCP or other public cloud technologies is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Containers, Kubernetes, microservice architectures is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.  
  • Strong understanding of System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodology, design patterns, and software engineering principles
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.  Ability to work independently or as part of a team on complex, time-sensitive projects.

About Sarvam Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC. About the Role We're looking for a frontend developer with a designer's eye to build Sarvam's web experiences. You'll start with our marketing website: the homepage, product and use-case pages, interactive demos and calculators. You'll write production code, build reusable UI systems and turn rough ideas into polished interfaces, working closely with design, marketing and product engineering. Key Responsibilities Build the interface, not just the mockup. Write production-ready Astro and React components with thoughtful layouts, typography and responsive behaviour. Own the implementation from first prototype to the final browser-sized detail. Build a UI system that holds together. Create reusable components, layout primitives and shared styles with clear APIs and sensible variants. Make the next page easier to build without turning every component into a 40-prop puzzle. Make it feel right. Build interactions, transitions and animations that make interfaces clearer and more enjoyable. Think through keyboard use, loading, empty and error states, reduced motion and what happens when the happy path isn't so happy. Prototype in code. Explore alternative layouts and interactions with designers, test ideas in the browser and refine the details together. You should be comfortable suggesting a better implementation, not waiting for every pixel and breakpoint to be specified. Build the useful bits properly. Develop interactive demos, calculators and forms; connect thm to APIs and content. Handle state, validation, asynchronous behaviour and failures. Keep accessibility, performance, metadata and measurement working as part of what you ship. Own the engineering quality. Make sound choices about component structure, rendering and hydration. Debug browser and performance issues, write appropriate tests, review code and check preview deployments. Ship maintainable changes that work beyond your own laptop. Astro, React, TypeScript and CSS are at the core of the work. We use GitHub for code review and Railway for development and pull-request previews. Sanity, ImageKit and PostHog support content, media and measurement. You'll work with engineering on staging and production releases. Requirements Have built and shipped interfaces you're proud to put your name on. Show us the actual thing, what you coded and the decisions you made. A live link beats a paragraph of adjectives. Have strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript fundamentals and hands-on React experience. You can work effectively in Astro and reason about component composition, state, rendering and browser behaviour. Have a good eye for visual design and the CSS skills to act on it. You care about spacing, type, hierarchy, responsive layouts and interaction details, and can turn that judgement into working code. Can work across design and engineering. You're comfortable starting from a rough brief, prototyping options and discussing trade-offs with designers. You can also take an established design and implement it faithfully. Can debug an unfamiliar frontend, integrate APIs and use Git, pull requests and automated checks confidently. You understand accessibility and web performance, and handle credentials and user data responsibly. Use AI coding tools with judgement. Let them help you move faster. Read the diff, test the result and be able to explain what you're shipping. 'The model wrote it' isn't a debugging strategy. Ask good questions when the brief is fuzzy. Explain trade-offs, suggest a practical way forward and use evidence before declaring that something needs fixing. Bonus points that are not dealbreakers You've built for B2B SaaS, developer tools or AI products. You've built component libraries, design systems or interactive prototypes that other people actually use. You've worked with animation, SVG, Canvas or other techniques that make complex ideas easier to explore on the web. You've used a headless CMS such as Sanity, or worked on technical SEO and analytics integrations without letting them take over the frontend. How to apply Skip the generic cover letter. Send us a couple of interfaces or web projects you've built, with a short note on what you personally designed and coded. Pick one and walk us through a component, interaction or tricky engineering decision. Code samples are welcome where you can share them. If there's a side project you're weirdly proud of, we'd like to see that too. Why Sarvam? Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar High ownership and high impact, from day one Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

About DevRev

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer, you will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to guide customers through the evaluation and adoption of our platform. Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will lead discovery, design tailored solutions, deliver impactful demos, and support technical validation through proofs of concept.

This role blends technical expertise with customer-facing communication, helping translate complex requirements into scalable solutions while clearly articulating business value.

 
What you'll do
  • Lead customer discovery to uncover business needs and define solution requirements
  • Design scalable solutions aligned to customer use cases and technical environments
  • Deliver tailored product demos that clearly communicate value and differentiation
  • Build and execute proofs of concept (PoCs) and technical validations
  • Translate customer requirements into architectures, integrations, and configurations
  • Partner with Sales to progress deals by addressing technical objections and risks
  • Support RFP/RFI responses and contribute to technical proposals
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success
  • Enable partners through training, workshops, and joint solution development
  • Develop reusable demo assets, playbooks, and technical documentation
 
What you'll bring
  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering / Sales Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Strong discovery and qualification skills with a consultative approach
  • Proven ability in solution design, translating use cases into scalable architectures
  • Experience delivering compelling demos and technical storytelling to diverse stakeholders
  • Hands-on experience with technical execution, including APIs, integrations, and PoCs
  • Ability to articulate business value and align technical solutions to customer outcomes
  • Solid understanding of modern SaaS architectures, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with tools such as Postman, SQL, and CRM/CX platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow)
  • Proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript is a plus
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.

Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.

Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.

Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.

That’s DevRev!

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We need a Marketing Technology Specialist for our APJ region. You will be the main contact for regional marketing teams. You will make sure they can use our tools for campaigns, events, and webinars.
Your work will cover three main areas:
  1. Fix technical issues quickly.
  2. Set up virtual events, live events, and mail campaigns.
  3. Train users on our platforms so they can do tasks on their own.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Regional Contact: Be the main tech contact for the APJ region. Answer questions and fix system problems.
  • Events & Campaigns: Build and assist with virtual events and live events. You will be using tools such as ON24, Splash, Cvent, and Sendoso.
  • User Training: Teach regional teams how to use our tools. Show them best practices so they can work independently.
  • System Setup: Learn our different marketing tools, like Demandbase and Adobe Experience Manager. Work with the Marketo and Salesforce teams. Make sure data moves correctly between all systems.
  • Global Teamwork: Meet with global peers. Spot common issues in your region, share solutions, and create standard processes.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on experience with major marketing tools. You need to know event platforms (ON24, Splash, Cvent), giftin tools (Sendoso), and content systems (Adobe Experience Manager).
  • Knowledge of Marketo and Salesforce. You must know how outside tools send data to them.
  • Problem-solving skills. You like finding out why a process stopped or why data did not sync between systems.
  • A focus on the user. You can explain technical steps clearly to team members who are not technical.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks at once and pay close attention to details.
  • Working hours that match the APJ region, plus time to talk with a global team.

Bonus Points

  • Certificates in Marketo, Salesforce, Cvent, Adobe Experience Manager, or ON24.
  • Past work with field marketing or demand generation teams in the APJ region.

 

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
